---
title: Sensor Overview
---



```{r}
#| label: init

library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(flextable)

sensors <- st_read("data/cbb_gwsHeader.gpkg")
rawdata <- read.csv("raw/element_valid_measurements.csv")

sensors <- sensors |> filter(Betreiber == "Zwillbrock")
```


```{r}
#| label: raw data Stats

rawdata <- left_join(rawdata, sensors, by = "ID")
rawdata$Datum_Zeit <- as_datetime(rawdata$Datum_Zeit)

# rawdata <- rawdata |>
#   filter(
#     Datum_Zeit >= as_date("2025-11-01") & Datum_Zeit <= as_date("2026-10-31")
#   )

number_of_measurements <- rawdata |>
  group_by(ID) |>
  summarise(
    first_measurement = date(min(Datum_Zeit)),
    n = n(),
    src10 = sum(SRC_Echoguete == 10),
    srssi10 = sum(SRSSI_Signalstaerke == 10),
    both10 = sum(SRC_Echoguete == 10 & SRSSI_Signalstaerke == 10)
  )


number_of_measurements$highqualityRatio <- round(
  number_of_measurements$both10 /
    number_of_measurements$n,
  2
)


measurement_range <- paste0(
  "Measurement Range: ",
  range(date(rawdata$Datum_Zeit))
)


flextable::flextable(number_of_measurements[
  order(number_of_measurements$highqualityRatio, decreasing = TRUE),
]) |>
  flextable::set_caption("Sensor Overview")
```
